official_secure_channel_note: Use only the named official website, secure HTTPS form, verified office phone, or in-person office path for sensitive case details and documents. If the current public instructions do not show a secure submission path, call the responsible election office first before sending records.
minimum_necessary_disclosure_note: Send only the personal information the current official process requires. Do not post or send full Social Security numbers, driver's license numbers, dates of birth, confidential residence details, court papers, custody records, or other sensitive identifiers through public, unverified, or generalized channels.
operability_now_note: Before relying on this path under same-day or near-cutoff pressure, verify that the responsible office, portal, site, or delivery route is still open and operating right now using the latest official hours/closure notice, current update page, or verified office phone.
deadline_imminence_note: Do not assume an older FAQ, PDF, screenshot, or cached directory still controls today's path. If the cutoff is near or may already have passed, confirm the current live deadline with the responsible office and pivot immediately to the stated fallback or confirmation path if the original route is no longer operable.
current_official_controls_note: The current directly governing state or local election-office source controls for this case. National routing pages, generalized official explainers, and archive summaries are routing aids only and are not substitutes for the current official instruction that directly governs the voter's jurisdiction and election scope.
superseding_notice_note: Older pages, PDFs, screenshots, packet inserts, or archived summaries may remain visible. Follow the most current official notice, form, correction, update, or replacement instruction and use the dated or last-updated cue when available.
unresolved_conflict_stop_note: If current official materials still materially conflict, disagree, or leave a controlling gap, do not synthesize an answer from fragments. Treat that unresolved conflict as a stop condition and use the responsible official office or help path for case-specific confirmation; move to the rights/safety escalation lane when the conflict is paired with likely wrongful denial, intimidation, discrimination, or unsafe exposure.
guardianship_alone_summary: Guardianship or conservatorship alone does not change voting rights unless the current public rule says a specific court finding controls eligibility.
court_finding_summary: Only a court order using the jurisdiction's current voting-capacity standard changes eligibility.
communication_standard_summary: If the jurisdiction uses a communication or affidavit-completion standard, publish that standard verbatim or in close plain-language paraphrase with the controlling source.
registration_or_restoration_summary: If a later order restores eligibility or confirms the voter remains eligible, publish whether the voter may register immediately, stays registered automatically, or must complete another election-office step.
assistance_vs_capacity_summary: Separate the eligibility question from the assistance question so the voter is not told to use an accommodation page as a substitute for the controlling capacity rule.

eligibility_models.plain_language: The voter remains eligible because guardianship alone does not remove voting rights under the current public rule.
eligibility_models.guardianship_or_conservatorship_rule: Treat the guardianship or conservatorship status alone as non-disqualifying unless a separate court finding says otherwise.
eligibility_models.court_finding_rule: No specific order removing voting rights has been entered.
eligibility_models.registration_rule: The voter may use the ordinary registration or ballot path if all other eligibility rules are met.
eligibility_models.restoration_or_review_rule: If another office claims the voter is ineligible, use the named review/help path to confirm the current status.
eligibility_models.help_path_rule: Contact the election office or clerk named in the current public rule when records are inconsistent.

eligibility_models.plain_language: A specific court finding currently limits voting rights under the jurisdiction's public rule.
eligibility_models.guardianship_or_conservatorship_rule: The status matters only because the court entered the named finding described on the public guidance page.
eligibility_models.court_finding_rule: Publish the current incapacity, communication, or affidavit-completion standard that controls this result.
eligibility_models.registration_rule: Do not route the voter through ordinary online registration if the public rule says a court finding currently blocks eligibility.
eligibility_models.restoration_or_review_rule: Use the named court-review or election-office path if a later order changes the finding or restores the right.
eligibility_models.help_path_rule: Contact the named clerk, registrar, county board, or disability-rights referral for time-sensitive review questions.

help_paths.label: Election office eligibility help
help_paths.use_when: The voter or helper needs the authoritative current rule, the correct form, or the right county or state contact for an unresolved capacity question.

help_paths.label: Court clerk or review contact named by public guidance
help_paths.use_when: A court order, restoration question, or inconsistent public record requires the named review or correction route.
